title: 高松宮記念の後に・アツアツ名勝負！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono's breathtakingly powerful stride and Biko Pegasus's awe-inspiring determination move all who witness them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono is deeply grateful to Biko Pegasus and thanks her rival for running her heart out and giving her the race of her life.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Back at Tracen Academy, Taiki Shuttle is watching the Takamatsunomiya Kinen with sparkling eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to have taken a great interest in Hishi Akebono and vows to train even harder for the sake of racing beside her in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next race goal is a huge event with new possibilities—the Yasuda Kinen!
